subject: Taxes
title: Capital Gains on Crypto
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Capital Gains on Crypto.

hook.text: Buy Bitcoin at $10,000, sell at $50,000—you owe capital gains tax on $40,000.

buildup.text: Short-term gains—held under a year—are taxed as ordinary income, up to 37%.

discovery.text: This creates a 'HODL' incentive. Holding crypto over a year can save 17 percentage points in tax over selling quickly.

twist.text: Unlike stocks, crypto trades 24/7. A midnight New Year's trade could decide between short-term and long-term rates.

climax.text: Crypto capital gains follow stock rules, but crypto's speed and volatility make the timing game far more intense.

punchline.text: Hold one year, save 17% in taxes. HODL isn't just a meme—it's tax strategy.

quiz.question: What's the maximum short-term capital gains tax rate on crypto?
